chemistry.notes: Estimated: Lucid's battery data page lists its Air packs (MY26+) as nickel-rich NMC; no Gravity page names its chemistry; same maker and 2170-class cells assumed.

nominal_voltage_class.notes: Wards: 926 V platform, up to 400 kW on 1000 V chargers (900 V class recorded as 800v).

preconditioning.notes: Lucid: Smart Preconditioning (automatic when routing to a fast charger) and a manual Precondition Battery button.

capacity_gross_kwh.notes: Estimated: 2027 hardware assumed unchanged from 2025-26. Wards: 123 kWh battery (usable not stated); KBB 2026 (Grand Touring, Dream Edition) agrees.

capacity_usable_kwh.notes: Electrek review: "a 924 V battery pack with 121 kWh of usable capacity for the Grand Touring". Presented as a spec by Electrek but not a Lucid page (Lucid spec sheet not found); other sites show 123 kWh as gross. Ratio 121/123 = 0.984.

ac_max_kw.notes: Lucid: AC up to 19.2 kW (80 A).

dc_max_kw.notes: Estimated: 2027 hardware assumed unchanged from 2025-26. Wards: up to 400 kW on 1000 V chargers (225 kW sustained at 500 V); Lucid page: 200 miles in 10.5 min at 400 kW.
